description: This PHP class defines a console command 'CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand' for creating a database savepoint with a specified name. It is part of the testing tools for the OrangeHRM system and interacts with the DatabaseBackupService to perform the savepoint creation.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class for creating a database savepoint in the OrangeHRM test environment.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command, 'instance:create-db-savepoint'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and required arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to create a database savepoint using the provided name argument, then outputs success message.
